embedded.title: Run rusthinq in Home Assistant
embedded.description: Home Assistant downloads and runs the rusthinq daemon, which LG ThinQ appliances connect to on this host. Appliances open HTTPS on port 443; if another port is used here, redirect 443 to it.

data_description.https_port: Where appliances are provisioned and register (443 unless a redirect points here)
data_description.mqtt_port: Announced to appliances when they register; any free port works

url.title: rusthinq management API
url.description: Connect to a rusthinq that is already running. For development: devices that also reach Home Assistant through MQTT would appear twice.

data_description.url: Base URL of the management API, for example http://127.0.0.1:44401

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the management API.
error.invalid_auth: The management API rejected the username or password.
error.invalid_prefix: The topic prefix must not be empty.
error.duplicate_ports: Each listener needs its own port.
